examples.title: Hermitian Metric on a Bundle
examples.content: A Hermitian metric h on a complex vector bundle E assigns to each fiber E_x a Hermitian inner product varying smoothly with x.
examples.formula: h: E \times_X E \to \mathbb{C}, \quad h(\lambda s, t) = \lambda h(s,t), \quad h(s,t) = \overline{h(t,s)}

examples.title: Chern Connection
examples.content: The Chern connection is the unique connection on (E, h) that is compatible with both the Hermitian metric and the holomorphic structure.

simulator.title: Non-trivial Line Bundle
simulator.description: The Mobius strip represents a non-orientable real line bundle. Complex line bundles have analogous twisting measured by Chern class.

applications.title: Gauge Theory
applications.description: Yang-Mills connections on Hermitian bundles describe fundamental forces in particle physics.

applications.title: Index Theory
applications.description: The Atiyah-Singer index theorem relates analytic and topological invariants of bundles.

concepts.name: Chern Classes
concepts.definition: Characteristic classes c_k(E) in H^{2k}(X, Z) measuring the twisting of a complex vector bundle E.

concepts.name: Curvature Form
concepts.definition: The (1,1)-form Theta = nabla^2 measuring the failure of parallel transport to be path-independent.

exercises.question: Show that the curvature of the Chern connection is a (1,1)-form.
exercises.hint: Use the decomposition of the connection into (1,0) and (0,1) parts.

exercises.question: Prove that c_1(L) = [i Theta / 2 pi] for a holomorphic line bundle L with Chern connection.
exercises.hint: Use local trivializations and compute the transition of the curvature form.

diagrams.title: Parallel Transport
diagrams.description: Visualize how vectors are transported along curves using the connection.
diagrams.instructions: The holonomy around a loop measures the integrated curvature.
